label: Rematch — the returning draft
location: The Ashen Shrine, the great hearth

recentEvents.value: The Continuance relit it in a cold shrine; it remembers each extinguishing, flame by flame.
The gate-light kindled again. The hearth-keepers did not need to be told what it meant.

unresolvedConflicts.value: You come back colder each time, little ember.

temporaryObjective.value: Ask him again to leave in peace — a hearth does not learn to hate the cold.
